title.narrative: Expanding Free Artistic Expression and Access to Culture in the Arab Region

description.narrative: This regional initiative focuses on artistic practices that are directly connected to free artistic expressions and on topics that address human rights through documentary film and documentary photography. Both practices have an inherent ability to expose social, political, and humanistic topics that uncover violations of human rights and give agency to communities and populations that are most vulnerable and marginalized. Results will be disaggregated by gender.
